global_design_rules.tone: Premium, clear, warm, reassuring, conversion-oriented, non-medicalizing. Elegant, clean white space.
global_design_rules.border_radius: rounded-2xl for soft borders on cards and surfaces, ensuring no sharp, clinical edges.
global_design_rules.shadows: Very soft ambient shadows, relying primarily on borders with #E7DDD3 for separation to maintain a grounded feel.
global_design_rules.hover_states: Subtle background shifts, active text colors, no aggressive transformations. Preserve the peaceful aura.
global_design_rules.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px for all interactive elements to ensure mobile accessibility.
global_design_rules.carousels: NO auto-carousels. All sliders must be user-initiated to respect user control and prevent CLS.

home.hero: Full width layout. #F7F3EE ivory background. Bold Cormorant Garamond H1. CTAs 'Découvrir ma routine' (primary) & 'Voir les best-sellers' (outline). Features a soft botanical lifestyle image.
home.cards_besoins: Grid layout representing entry by 'Need'. 3 cols desktop, 2 cols tablet, 1 col mobile. Use minimal illustrations or soft lifestyle crops.
home.reassurance: Full width banner block with #C0B4A6 background. 3 to 4 trust points (icons + synthetic text).
home.bestsellers: 4 columns product grid on desktop, 2 on tablet/mobile.
home.conseils: Editorial block, 50/50 split of warm image and narrative text. Focus on accompaniment.
home.ateliers_expertes: 3 columns grid displaying expert portraits and physical workshops.
home.boutique_geneva: Full width immersive image of the physical boutique in Geneva. Text overlay or side-by-side. Very warm, cozy vibes.
home.reviews: Clean review cards in a grid or flex wrap, highlighting trust.
home.footer: Deep Burgundy #4D1E19 background with #FFFFFF text for contrast and brand affirmation. Clear columns.

category.layout: Breadcrumb on top. Large H1 and intro text. Content: Sidebar with sticky filters (desktop) / Drawer filters (mobile). Product grid 3 cols desktop.
category.filters: Sections for: besoin, flux, usage, taille, prix, disponibilité.
category.cards: Product cards must include image, mini conseil text, price, and quick add button.

product.layout: 2 columns on desktop. Image Gallery on left. Sticky Buy Box on right.
product.buy_box: H1 title, price, variants (size, color). Primary CTA for Add to Cart. 3-5 synthetic benefits listed cleanly.
product.accordions: Structured with Shadcn Accordion: description, composition, utilisation, livraison, fabrication, FAQ.
product.cross_sell: Related products grid below main fold.
product.reviews: Customer reviews section at the bottom.
product.assistance: Block 'Besoin d'aide pour choisir ?' linking to guide or contact.

cart.features: Free shipping threshold indicator (progress bar), list of items with quantity adjusters, subtotal, and secure checkout button.

checkout.layout: Multi-step structure (Information, Shipping, Payment), highly focused, removing main nav/footer distractions.
checkout.features: Stripe payment integration element. Clean summary pane on the right.

about.layout: Editorial layout, heavy use of imagery (team, founders, mission), 50/50 blocks overlapping softly, alternating #FFFFFF and #F7F3EE backgrounds.

contact.layout: 2 columns desktop. Left: Contact info, map, email, social links. Right: Simple form (Resend email integration) with shadcn Input and Textarea components.

faq.layout: Centered narrow layout (max-w-3xl). Grouped accordion items. Clear search bar at the top.

store_geneva.layout: Immersive hero image of the boutique. 2 cols details (Address/Hours on left, Map/Info on right). Expert cards highlighting on-site team.

guides.layout: Blog/Article grid layout. Featured guide span 2 cols, others 1 col. Article cards with soft borders, imagery, category badge, and title.

accessibility.contrast: Maintain WCAG 2.2 AA. Text #111111 and #4D1E19 on #F7F3EE or #FFFFFF meets this standard. Be careful with white text on #C0B4A6.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must exhibit a visible focus state: focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#4D1E19] focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-[#F7F3EE]
accessibility.aria: Use aria-expanded on accordion and drawer components. Include precise aria-labels on icon buttons.
accessibility.hierarchy: Enforce strict semantic Hn structure: H1 -> H2 -> H3. No visual headings should bypass the semantic flow.

tech_instructions.ui_components: Mandatory to use shadcn/ui. Required: Button, Card, Accordion, Dialog, Sheet, Select, Input, Label, Tabs, Separator, Badge. Toast notifications via 'sonner'. Extract these to /app/frontend/src/components/ui/.
tech_instructions.performance: Target LCP < 2.5s, CLS < 0.1, INP < 200ms. Ensure AVIF/WebP formats and lazy-load non-critical imagery.
tech_instructions.testing: CRITICAL: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive/key informational elements using kebab-case role-based names (e.g., data-testid='hero-primary-cta').
tech_instructions.styling: Use standard html and Tailwind CSS for main layouts instead of rigidly relying on pre-built structural components when creative overlapping or spacing is needed.
